english.title: Issuing body fail to provide information to the central database
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being an issuing body, failed to provide information required by virtue of regulation 15 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..) to the central database within

(A)_[24 hours of creating the information]_
(B)_[24 hours of amending the information]_
(C)_[24 hours of a request from the Welsh Ministers]_
(D)_[the extended time limit granted by the Welsh Ministers under subsection (2) of that Regulation]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 15, 22(3) and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
issuing body failed to provide
the identification details described in Article 27(1) of the EU Regulation, within 24 hours of the information being created / amended OR
the information recorded in the issuing body's database under Article 38(1) of the Commission Implementing Regulation (EU 2015 / 262), within 24 hours of the information being created / amended OR
other information as reasonably requested by the Welsh Ministers, in relation to the issuing of an ID by the issuing body or the carrying out of its functions, within 24 hours of the request
to the central database

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
